🎬 David Makes Man (2019–2021) — Drama
David Makes Man follows David, a gifted teenage boy growing up in a difficult environment while carrying the weight of expectations from his family, school, and community. As he tries to build a better future, he constantly finds himself caught between the world he comes from and the future he hopes to create.
David is intelligent and ambitious, but life around him presents challenges that make his path far from simple. He has to navigate friendships, family responsibilities, poverty, and the pressures of growing up while trying to understand who he really wants to become.
The series explores themes of identity, family, friendship, ambition, trauma, and resilience. David's journey shows how difficult it can be for a young person to pursue their dreams while carrying circumstances they never chose.
More than just a coming-of-age drama, David Makes Man is a thoughtful story about finding your identity, overcoming difficult circumstances, and discovering the strength to imagine a different future. ❤️‍🩹
